crawlNote: Support portal homepage fetched. Individual articles not line-scored. This is the high-water mark in the first five, not a claim of perfection.
summary: Zerodha’s support home is a map, not a slogan. Categories match the jobs a customer actually has. August 2026 bulletins sit on the same page. Ticket creation is documented, not hidden behind “chat with us”.

dimensions.label: Internal consistency
dimensions.note: No colliding numbers on the homepage. Information architecture is consistent with the products they sell.

dimensions.label: Help vs marketing
dimensions.note: Support portal does not sell. Marketing stays on zerodha.com.

dimensions.label: Freshness
dimensions.note: Surveillance and buyback bulletins dated August 2026 on the support home.

dimensions.label: High-intent coverage
dimensions.note: Account opening, funds in/out, margins, reports, tickets. Everyday tasks are first-class.

dimensions.label: Path to a human
dimensions.note: Ticket creation is a documented article. Phone-first is not the design. That is a choice, and it is stated.

dimensions.label: Bot / chat honesty
dimensions.note: No pretend-human widget on the homepage. Ticket is the path.

findings.title: Human help is a ticket, not a phone number on the home
findings.whyItHurts: Some customers will bounce looking for a number. Zerodha has chosen tickets on purpose. Say that in one line on the home: “We answer tickets, not phone queues.”
findings.fix: A single sentence under the search box. Keep the ticket article as the next click.

evidence.quote: Learn how to create a ticket
